race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 3yof Trotting Final (G1)
race.comment: HALLEBESOFINE (3) looks to be peaking at the right time having come from a couple of spots wider to cruise home by 13.6m in her heat at this circuit and distance last week. Hasn't missed a place this time in and this is the best draw she has had all preparation so she should get her chance. QUEEN OF SEES (1) is a progressive filly who came from wider for a resuming in last week's heat. She has clearly returned in good order and should only be improved. The ace draw could see her deliver again. JILLIBY AURA (10) took advantage of a good draw to lead and win when resuming last week. Draws on the back row this time but she is capable and with the gaps she looks dangerous. NSW Oaks winner GLADIATRIX (13) isn't the most reliable filly in terms of manners but she has the talent when on her game. ALDEBARAN ADA (7) draws out but ended last campaign with a Nutrien Classic win over HALLEBESOFINE and will be fitter for a decent fresh effort last week.
